ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: On 32-bit targets, replace truncating `*remaining as usize` / `r as usize` casts in the Length and chunked-body read paths with `usize::try_from(...).unwrap_or(usize::MAX)` so that u64 lengths exceeding usize::MAX saturate instead of silently truncating, allowing large bodies to be fully read (downstream u64 bookkeeping still tracks the real remaining count).
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title `fix(http1): fix reading large bodies on 32-bit systems` and body: `On 32-bit systems, the cast of the length to read from a u64 to a usize could truncate, and cause less to be read. If the length was larger than usize::MAX, the end could not be read. To fix this, we use a saturating cast pattern instead. Closes #4055`. Reviewer comment confirms the truncation is guaranteed once remaining exceeds usize::MAX, not merely rare.
